Free Google Skills Arcade progress tool

Arcade Points Calculator

Paste your public Google Skills profile link to calculate your Arcade points, review earned badges, check the skill badge list, and see your league tier and milestones.

How to use the calculator

  1. Open your public Google Skills profile and copy its link.
  2. Paste the profile link into the calculator.
  3. Choose Calculate Points to view your progress and badge breakdown.

No Google password or sign-in is requested. The calculator reads public profile information.
